name: TreeView
description: A nested, file-explorer style tree whose folders expand and collapse with an animated height reveal and a rotating chevron. Supports single selection, indent guides and controlled or uncontrolled selection and expansion.
a11yNotes: Implements the WAI-ARIA tree pattern: role="tree" (named by its header or aria-label) containing role="treeitem" elements with aria-level, aria-setsize, aria-posinset, aria-selected and aria-expanded on folders; nested items live in role="group" lists. Roving tabindex gives one Tab stop. Up/Down move between visible items, Right expands a folder or moves to its first child, Left collapses or moves to the parent, Home/End jump to the first/last visible item, Enter/Space select (and toggle folders). Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion folders open instantly.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.type: TreeNode[]  // { id?: string; label: string; children?: TreeNode[] }
propsApi.description: Tree data. A node with a children array is a folder; ids default to the slash-joined label path (e.g. 'src/app/page.tsx').

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible name of the tree, shown as a header when showHeader is true.

propsApi.name: showHeader
propsApi.description: Show the label as an uppercase header above the tree.

propsApi.name: defaultValue
propsApi.description: Initially selected node id when uncontrolled.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the id of the newly selected node.

propsApi.name: expanded
propsApi.description: Controlled list of expanded folder ids.

propsApi.name: defaultExpanded
propsApi.description: Initially expanded folder ids when uncontrolled.

propsApi.name: onExpandedChange
propsApi.description: Called with the next list of expanded folder ids.

propsApi.name: expandAll
propsApi.description: Start with every folder expanded (uncontrolled only; overrides defaultExpanded).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Selection highlight, selection bar and folder icon color.

propsApi.name: showIcons
propsApi.description: Show folder and file icons (files get an extension-colored dot).

propsApi.name: showGuides
propsApi.description: Draw vertical indent guides for nested levels.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
